people.name: Mr. Prithvi Vachani
people.role: Additional Director in the capacity of Executive Director
people.evidence_quote: Appointment of Mr. Prithvi Vachani (DIN: 08247706) as an Additional Director in the capacity of Executive Director of the Company for a period of 5 (five) consecutive years with effect from 30 th October, 2026, along with his remuneration, subject to approval of shareholders of the Company.
people.tenure_quote: for a period of 5 (five) consecutive years
people.bio_quote: Mr. Prithvi Vachani is currently serving as the Vice President at Dixon Technologies (India) Limited. A 2017 graduate of Bentley University, Mr. Prithvi quickly demonstrated his strategic acumen upon entering the professional arena. His exceptional foresight and leadership were notably displayed when he successfully orchestrated a major collaboration with boAt, India’s leading audio product company, resulting in the production of innovative twin wireless speakers.
